newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends mostly lower, buying interest light.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends mostly lower, buying interest light.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed lower as buying interest was light for commercial offers over the market in the January and March, traders said.
"Term was offering the March and January but there was only limited selling by them," a trader said.
Term Commodities is the marketing arm of Louis Dreyfus Corp.
Rice was underpinned by a strong number in USDA's weekly export sales report.
Rice closed one cent per cwt higher to one lower, with November down one at $10.29.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 400 contracts, down from 616 Wednesday.
